checkpoint: ROADMAP ITEM 4 §11 — atomic departure seam controlled gates
scopeLimit: The seam is NOT reachable from ordinary fission — D16 reads the sources to prove it. These gates drive the production writer directly. They prove the departure TRANSITION is truthful; they prove nothing about travel, return or stabilization, none of which exist, and nothing about natural occurrence.

fixtures.claim: a departure_ready attempt with a viable residual departs
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the seam genuinely produced a departure; every later gate reads this world

fixtures.claim: population and all three cohorts are conserved exactly, measured after the mutation
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: people genuinely moved, so the conservation is over a real transfer

fixtures.claim: a deliberately corrupted ledger is detected rather than reported conserved
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the healthy ledger passes in the same run, so the detections are detections

fixtures.claim: the successor is created at the parent's tile, never at the target
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the target genuinely differs from the parent tile, so co-residence is a choice

fixtures.claim: the successor is living, is not established, and cannot fission
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the PARENT is established in the same world, so the successor's false is discriminating

fixtures.claim: no viable status is asserted at departure
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the parent DOES carry a viability status, so the successor's absence is deliberate

fixtures.claim: no storage, expedition or receipt is created by departing
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the parent HAS storage, so the successor's zero is an honest absence rather than a world with no storage at all

fixtures.claim: the split does not make anybody less hungry
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the parent was genuinely hungry, so 'not improved' is a real claim

fixtures.claim: acute condition and death memory are carried, not reset and not duplicated
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the parent genuinely carried acute risk and a death memory

fixtures.claim: the resulting world has exactly one current owner for the departure
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the parent genuinely retains its attempt record as provenance

fixtures.claim: parent and successor are recognised as one split; an unrelated band is not
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the real pair IS protected, so the stranger's false is a real negative

fixtures.claim: a departure is refused from every phase except departure_ready
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: departure_ready IS accepted in the same run

fixtures.claim: a departure that would strand the parent is refused by the residual authority
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: a healthy parent DOES depart in the same run, so the refusal is not a broken seam

fixtures.claim: when the residual authority revises the request down, the smaller group is the one that leaves
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: a revision genuinely occurred; without one this gate would prove nothing

fixtures.claim: the parent's cohorts after are its own minus the departing group, not a re-derived shape
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the fixed-ratio shape genuinely differs from the true remainder here, so the check discriminates

fixtures.claim: nothing in production calls this seam, so ordinary behaviour cannot change
fixtures.nonVacuityNote: the legacy path genuinely still exists in demography.ts

fixtures.claim: the same request produces a byte-identical world and ledger
a refused departure returns the original world with nobody moved
